name: gyroscopic-card-tilt
title: Gyroscopic Card Tilt
description: A layered holographic identity card that tilts dynamically in 3D space based on mouse angle, simulating physical glass inertia.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Pointer Perspective Tilt: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
